author: Aevy TV
description:
The Delhi Transport department is reportedly launching a dedicated online portal where eligible EV owners can apply for purchase and scrapping incentives. Once your application is verified, the amount will be transferred straight to your bank account through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. The government will clarify exactly what documents you'll need as and when the portal goes live.
But here's what's important: you must apply within 30 days of your vehicle's Registration Certificate (RC) being generated.
Who needs to apply: Purchase incentives cover electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers and N1 category trucks. Scrapping incentives are for owners replacing an older vehicle with an EV.
Who does NOT need to apply: Electric car buyers don't need to submit anything separately. For cars priced under ₹30 lakh, the road tax and registration fee exemptions apply at registration.
In the next few months, the portal is also expected to show real-time EV charging station availability,
title: Everything about Delhi's EV Policy 2.0
